en: Colored postcard illustration of a church with green roofs and onion-shaped spires, surrounded by trees and a grassy churchyard. A separate wooden bell tower with a steep, shingled roof stands to the right. In the foreground, several people in traditional folk clothing pose on the lawn. Handwritten text appears across the sky area at the top, and printed text runs vertically along the right edge.
